name: Pledge
verified: Two pledges of 0.01 GEN each, two claims from a second account. nike.com: validators served the silent knock and were refused the declared one, claim upheld, 0.002 GEN paid to the claimant. walmart.com: served both ways, claim rejected, nothing paid.
note: Value moves on Studionet. On testnet-asimov emit_transfer records a payout and leaves balances untouched, so a contract whose point is that money moves lives here.
